limitations: The 'not detected in liver' criterion uses the HPA RNA detection threshold (mRNA below 1 nTPM); a protein could still be present in liver at very low levels above the assay's limit of detection.
Tissue enrichment is defined as ≥4-fold higher mRNA in pancreas versus any other tissue; genes meeting a lower fold-change threshold in pancreas are excluded.
